organisations.name: Part III Action Research & Resource Centre
organisations.what: Helped survivors of domestic violence apply in Delhi's revision, by its own account, and from that work published a guidebook in English and Hindi in October 2026 that goes through each step from the enumeration form to the appeals. It is a collective of lawyers, researchers and social workers with offices in New Delhi and Patna that gives legal aid to survivors of gender-based and identity-based violence.
organisations.source_outlet: Part III, Guidebook: SIR (Special Intensive Revision), Delhi (own publication), credits page
organisations.quote: This guide is the result of our experience supporting DV survivors in applying for the SIR (Delhi).
organisations.notes: SELF-REPORTED: the only statement of the help given is the guide's own credits page, which names Delhi and gives no count, place within Delhi or date. The guide's page on part-three.org is dated 26 October 2026 and the PDF linked there was created on 30 October 2026, with Delhi's dates as the Commission revised them on 29 October. A Hindi edition is at https://part-three.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/sir-hindi-1.pdf. The organisation describes itself on https://part-three.org/our-work-2-2/ as a collective of lawyers, researchers, social workers and community engagement fellows giving legal aid to survivors of identity- and gender-based violence, based in Delhi and Bihar; the guide's back cover says it has offices in New Delhi and Patna and that the guide has no affiliation with the Government of Delhi. It is a program of the Part III Foundation. No party link found. The credits name two individuals as researchers and a designer; none is carried. Only the public email and website are given as contact, on the owner's instruction.
